description: This file contains utility functions for generating JavaScript validation scripts and HTML forms for creating new records in the SugarCRM/VtigerCRM system, specifically for the Settings module's Forms component.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side validation of form data.

methods.name: get_new_record_form
methods.description: Creates an HTML form for entering a new record with dynamic fields based on database query.
